fixture_inputs.name: pinned_hawkeye_constants
fixture_inputs.purpose: Verify production program, log authority, global configuration, Hawkeye program, and return version against pinned source.

fixture_inputs.name: scrubbed_hawkeye_return_shape
fixture_inputs.purpose: Exercise return-data shape handling without committing raw return bytes or trader-specific values.

fixture_inputs.name: synthetic_market_context
fixture_inputs.purpose: Provide local validator context for market, funding, BBO, and liquidation-price view categories without claiming live market correctness.

fixture_outputs.name: hawkeye_return_version_gate
fixture_outputs.claim_boundary: Confirms only that a fixture declares the expected Hawkeye return version; it does not prove account decode or replay readiness.

fixture_outputs.name: view_category_coverage
fixture_outputs.claim_boundary: Confirms only that validator cases cover the planned view categories; it does not prove exact oracle input identity.

fixture_outputs.name: execution_surface_rejection
fixture_outputs.claim_boundary: Confirms that instruction building, signing, submission, asset control, and funded execution remain disabled.

negative_cases.name: beta_program_rejected
negative_cases.expected_rejection: Reject a fixture that uses the beta Phoenix program as production.

negative_cases.name: raw_return_data_rejected
negative_cases.expected_rejection: Reject a fixture that commits raw Hawkeye return bytes.

negative_cases.name: premature_replay_claim_rejected
negative_cases.expected_rejection: Reject a fixture that claims liquidation replay or execution readiness.

known_limitations: This contract is a validator design artifact, not a decoded Phoenix account dataset.
No raw account data, raw return data, trader addresses, credentials, signing material, or private execution data are committed.
Hawkeye view coverage does not prove deployed bytecode equivalence, exact oracle input identity, account-level decode, liquidation replay, or live market correctness.
